changelog: Initial open-source release. Multi-agent memory broadcast tool. Pure file-ops, zero network, zero LLM, zero pip dependencies. Idempotent upsert into MEMORY.md / AGENTS.md / TOOLS.md / USER.md across multiple workspaces in one shot. Supports explicit --target, auto --discover-under, --dry-run, JSON output. Works on OpenClaw, Claude Code, Cursor, and any agent runtime with Markdown-based per-project memory.
